name: Advanced Order Status For WooCommerce – Custom Status Management & Workflow Automation
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
🚀 Premium Addons for Your Store:
* Conditional Store Restrictions (PRO) – The ultimate access control engine for WooCommerce.
* Price & Cart Hider (PRO) – Professional Catalog Mode & B2B pricing control.

Advanced Order Status for WooCommerce by VerseSofts is the ultimate solution to optimize your specific store’s fulfillment process. Create, edit, and manage custom order statuses that fit your unique business workflow instead of relying solely on default WooCommerce options.

By utilizing our intuitive interface, you can effortlessly add color-coded labels, assign distinct Dashicons, and utilize bulk actions to significantly increase your team’s order management efficiency.

✨ Key Features

  • Unlimited Custom Statuses: Create as many tailored order statuses as your exact business workflow requires.
  • Visual Customization: Assign distinct colors and intuitive Dashicons to every status label for immediate visual identification.
  • Bulk Actions Support: Update order statuses rapidly directly from the WooCommerce orders screen using standard bulk actions.
  • HPOS Compatible: Certified to support WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage for maximum database speed and reliability.
  • Email Triggers: Integrates flawlessly with WooCommerce email notifications to keep customers informed upon status changes.
  • Native UX Integration: A lightweight and clean UI that looks like it belongs perfectly inside your WooCommerce dashboard.

💼 Perfect For

  • Dropshippers: Track items ordered from suppliers vs. shipped to customers.
  • Manufacturers: Monitor items in assembly, quality check, or packing stages.
  • B2B / Wholesale: Track internal approvals, credit checks, or net-30 payment statuses.
  • Local Pickup Stores: Clearly distinguish between “Preparing” and “Ready for Pickup”.

Why Choose VerseSofts?

We build professional-grade tools to help your WooCommerce store scale. Explore our full range of solutions on our Official WooCommerce Marketplace Profile.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Advanced Order Status for WooCommerce.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Order Statuses to start creating your new workflow steps.
sections.faq:
Can I edit existing core WooCommerce order statuses?

No, this plugin focuses purely on securely adding new custom statuses. Default statuses remain unchanged to guarantee core platform stability.

Will custom statuses work with email notifications?

Yes! You can trigger standard or custom emails when an order transitions into your new status.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your custom statuses will revert to fallback WooCommerce statuses visually, but your data is preserved. Re-activating will instantly restore your visual workflow.

Is this compatible with HPOS?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce’s latest standards, including HPOS and Blocks.
